hypothesis: Concealed and overlooked Quaternary geothermal faults in the Great Basin systematically escape surface aerial mapping for two distinct physical reasons: (1) range-front and intrabasin normal faults dipping ~60 degrees offset dense/magnetic Mesozoic basement horizontally down-dip into the hanging wall by Delta_x = z_base / tan(60 deg) while hydrothermal smectite/illite clay caps and shallow thermal/sinter plumes migrate laterally down topographic/hydraulic gradient (-grad z_dem), and (2) subdued Holocene piedmont scarps span both the 75.3% 1m LiDAR zone and the 24.7% non-LiDAR Great Basin gap where pluvial Lake Lahontan/Bonneville shorelines mimic scarps. Coupling 60-degree hanging-wall back-projection, upslope thermal/sinter deconvolution, paleoshoreline-filtered 1m/10m scarp + chi-ksn breaklines, fold-proper visible relay/tip anatomy, and direct continuous-kernel self-credit calibration m*(x) = E[max_g k(d(x,g)) | X] under Dinkelbach CELF allocation will recover whole withheld fault systems while generalizing across blind off-catalogue basins.
non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene pluvial paleoshorelines (Lake Lahontan ~1,330 m and Lake Bonneville ~1,555 m constant-contour beach ridges without basement offset or ksn jump) and valley-floor evaporite playas / lateral geothermal outflow plumes (high interior cond_surf and displaced hot-spring outflow with zero basement step).

registered_transform: 1) Back-project hanging-wall basement steps along -grad(iso_grav_anom) by Delta_x = clip(max(depth_to_base_surf, 0) / tan(60 deg), 0, 16 px). 2) Back-advect shallow 2m probe F2mDAB, paleo-sinter, and quartz geothermometer plumes upslope along +grad(z_dem) by 600 m and 1,500 m. 3) Combine 1m LiDAR dipole scarps (NaN outside LiDAR for native tree missingness routing) with 10m slope/curvature/ksn jumps and explicit Lahontan (1,330 m) + Bonneville (1,555 m) shoreline penalty. 4) Compute fold-proper visible-only relay/bend/damage-zone features strictly from fold['visible']. 5) Fit out-of-fold calibrated p*(u) and direct continuous-kernel self-credit m*(x) = E[max_g max(0, 1 - d(x,g)/3) | X], blend with pure physics head for far-basin discovery, and emit binary {0, 1} dots via unmodified vendor/gems57/emit.py::dinkelbach_allocate.
single_feature_canary: Symmetric ROC AUC on every included feature alone across pooled withheld whole-component positives vs off-catalogue negatives. Any single feature with symmetric AUC > 0.90 halts execution immediately until leakage is eliminated.
